{{Wireless adapter |brand=Sony |model=WU600-TS |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=04/10/2009 |manuf_country= |manuf=CyberTAN |manuf_model=WU600-TS |manuf_rev= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=AK8WU600-TS |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4323 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device is apparently used in the BDP-S560 Blu-ray player.
"3753-60000104G" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
This device is shown with two [http://www.skyworksinc.com/Product.aspx?ProductID=946 '''SiGe''' ('''Skyworks''') 2548A / SE2548A dual band a/b/g/n front end modules].
A MAC label on the device in the FCC photos has a MAC with a 00:01:36 ('''CyberTAN''') OUI.
